September 23, 1971
2014-12-12T00:00:00+06:00 | The Daily Star
https://www.thedailystar.net/september-23-1971-54696

Indian government decides to raise the ‘Bangladesh Crisis’ matter in UN General Assembly.

Returning from his week-long West Pakistan trip, PDP Chief Nurul Amin tells journalists: “I have returned with fresh confidence and hopes about sustaining Pakistan’s solidarity.”

Education Minister Abbas Ali Khan meets Bihari leaders of Mohammadpur, Mirpur and Old Dhaka, led by MRA Rizvi.

Madrasa students are trying to save the country; they are the true torchbearers of the patriots, says Matiur Rahman Nizami in a ceremony held by Islami Chhatra Sangha. “Because they love Islam, they love Pakistan. Meanwhile, students of universities and colleges, who get all sort of facilities, are acting against the state.” He adds.
